verification.pre_render_simulation: tools/simulate_geography_partb_prerender.py ran sessionize, MCQ rebalance, manual ASCII master embedding, ASCII master validation, core-completeness checks and the deep semantic content audit for every topic before any PDF was rendered. All six returned empty error and defect lists.
verification.post_finalize_assertion: tools/assert_v2_tracker_record.py reloaded EXPORT-PDF-STATUS.json after each refresh.finalize and asserted the exact new learner-v2 record existed exactly once with approved false and real artifact paths, before the next topic began.
verification.programmatic_proof: tools/prove_geography_partb_batch.py independently proved 15 sessions, 80 unique MCQs, an A20/B20/C20/D20 distribution, a strict A-B-C-D cycle, 12 embedded and 12 registered ASCII panels, 13 graphical stages, the 10/10/15/15/20/20 Mains weights, 20 fact anchors, required H2 order with register notes last, complete Basic and Advanced owner heading preservation, and live PDF page counts for all six topics.

issues_fixed: tools/generate_geography_common.py assumed every topic superseded a legacy-v1 record. It now accepts SUPERSEDES_TEMPLATE = None and emits supersedes null, which is required for the five Part-B topics that hold no prior tracker history.
tools/geography_generator_test_support.py now accepts a null expected supersedes template so the shared batch contract can assert a first-generation learner-v2 record.

tools/notions_style_ascii_master.py MANUAL_SPEC_FILENAMES and the shared coverage assertions in tools/test_refresh_all_v2_learning_sessions.py were updated to the live 233-topic / 2668-panel baseline instead of a guessed figure.

An initial geography-37 draft carried 21 fact anchors, which broke the 20-fact contract and the session-plan coverage set. The cultural and social scope anchors were merged into one and every dependent Mains and session index was recomputed.
